checks.workload: 2, 8, 64 and 65 sources under zero heap allowance and both cancellation scopes.
checks.invariant: Retain ordered source references inline, preserve the existing 64-relation search bound and allocate no heap scratch.

checks.workload: Seventeen interleaved predicates per relation across 2, 8 and 64 relation groups.
checks.invariant: Preserve original predicate identities/order, equate live buffer allocations with reservations and release on ancestor rejection/cancellation.

checks.workload: Qualified, unique unqualified, ambiguous, unknown, mixed-alias, conditional, membership and subquery predicates.
checks.invariant: Keep exactly the same eligible local predicates, relation order and per-relation conjunct order.

checks.workload: 65,536 WHERE conjuncts with a single table or no source.
checks.invariant: Allocate no unused predicate-reference list and retain the original WHERE expression.

checks.workload: Resolve a four MiB column name directly from its existing relation statistics.
checks.invariant: Resolve the original alias and column allocations with zero new heap bytes.

checks.workload: Resolve unique, shared, unknown and case-distinct names across 1/2/8/64 relations and 1/64/1024 shared columns in forward and reverse order.
checks.invariant: Preserve exact owner identities and ambiguity without copying names or constructing another column index.

checks.workload: Move statistics containing an unused four MiB column into a two-source native optimizer request with zero allowance.
checks.invariant: Reject graph admission with 53200 below 16 KiB new allocation, preserving both original statistics calls and releasing the request allowance.

checks.workload: Estimate three relations in non-lexical order, then reject the second provider cardinality.
checks.invariant: Preserve callback order, exact result slots, first-error identity and buffer cleanup while keeping source metadata immutable.

checks.workload: Pass an already owned query with a four MiB literal to an optimizer whose resource acquisition returns 53200.
checks.invariant: Propagate the original diagnostic before metadata capture with less than four KiB additional allocation.

checks.workload: Unwind while acquiring resources for an already owned query containing a four MiB literal.
checks.invariant: Release the original input during unwind without copying it or acquiring statistics/rule inputs.

checks.workload: Optimize 8,192 parameter rows through the actual retained-source adapter with 64 KiB request workspace on all four providers.
checks.invariant: Keep the original outer and row-vector addresses, allocate less than 16 KiB additional storage and release temporary resources.

checks.workload: Optimize a borrowed three-row utility query twice through the native CTAS adapter on all four providers.
checks.invariant: Retain independent destination row vectors, preserve parameter identities and keep later optimization unaffected by mutations to the first output.

checks.workload: Create empty default, owned and collected statistics and clone their handles.
checks.invariant: Keep all empty observations allocation-free.

checks.workload: Retain a four MiB MCV catalog snapshot through 64 independent readers.
checks.invariant: Allocate no new storage, retain the original map and payload addresses and release the generation after its last reader.

checks.workload: Replace an MCV entry through a standalone relation builder while an earlier reader retains its statistics.
checks.invariant: Keep the earlier value and selectivity unchanged and give the changed builder an independent generation.

checks.workload: Attach an owned map containing a four MiB MCV value to both optimizer estimators.
checks.invariant: Retain the original payload address in both estimators with less than four KiB additional allocation.

checks.workload: Capture a four MiB MCV catalog generation through both native statement and retrieval planning adapters on all four providers.
checks.invariant: Retain the original payload address with less than 16 KiB additional allocation across both captures.

checks.workload: Retain statistics through ANALYZE, transactional publication, rollback, commit, close and persistent reopen on all four providers.
checks.invariant: Publish the correct row counts and bounds while earlier captured generations remain immutable and committed rows survive reopening.

checks.workload: Select a join with a four MiB alias, qualifier or table name under a zero request allowance.
checks.invariant: Reject with 53200 below 16 KiB additional allocation while retaining the original name address and both ordered statistics callbacks.

checks.workload: Capture a table with a four MiB alias and retained statistics before a function whose access cost is unavailable.
checks.invariant: Allocate no heap storage, stop at the same callback and release the captured statistics handle without changing the source.

checks.workload: Insert three ordered keys, replace at capacity, reject another node, remove one key and reuse the released space.
checks.invariant: The sorted values remain exact, each live node retains its complete reservation, replacement allocates no node and final drop releases all capacity.

checks.workload: Insert under zero allowance and replace an existing key after either cancellation scope fires.
checks.invariant: Zero allowance rejects without an allocation; cancellation preserves the original value and removal still frees its node and lease.

checks.workload: Borrow a four MiB key through controlled insertion, consumer unwind and the ordinary map adapter.
checks.invariant: The original key address survives, charged bytes equal the node allocation, and unwind releases every node reservation.

checks.workload: Infer a simple cross-relation equality containing a four MiB column name.
checks.invariant: Keep the original expression and key addresses with less than four KiB additional allocation instead of copying the payload.

checks.workload: Intersect conjunctions with repeated reversed equalities, first-branch-only keys and later-branch-only keys.
checks.invariant: Keep exactly the common canonical keys, the first original expression and orientation, and release temporary nodes before returning the exact output leases.

checks.workload: Exhaust an ancestor allowance during union and intersection pruning, cancel either request scope and unwind after success.
checks.invariant: Reject with 53200 or 57014 at the owning operation, preserve the sibling reservation and release all partial workspace below four KiB additional allocation.

checks.workload: Move an existing four MiB expression through a four-slot buffer, unwind another buffer and reject a 65536-slot request.
checks.invariant: Slot allocation equals its retained reservation; moving a payload preserves its address without retiring buffer capacity, and failure or unwind preserves sibling ownership.

checks.workload: Plan a three-table disjunctive equality under constrained request memory, then execute it directly, prepared and with EXPLAIN ANALYZE MEMORY on all four providers.
checks.invariant: Reject with 53200 below 256 KiB additional allocation, return independently captured PostgreSQL 18.4 IDs 1 and 2, retain exact inferred-output leases through 64 allocation-free shared handles and cache invalidation, and release them with the last owner.

checks.workload: Project a four MiB executable to its query and back, then share it with 64 readers.
checks.invariant: Projection and reader clones allocate nothing, preserve payload identities and retain all constructor leases until the last reader.

checks.workload: Exhaust the exact copy allowance before query boxing or shared-wrapper construction.
checks.invariant: Return 53200 below four KiB diagnostic allocation, release rejected input owners and preserve a sibling reservation.

checks.workload: Cancel either scope before sharing and unwind after projecting a four MiB owned query.
checks.invariant: Both cancellation tokens preserve 57014 and every failure or unwind returns all executable reservations.

checks.workload: Move a controlled four MiB query out of its original root box.
checks.invariant: Unboxing allocates nothing and releases exactly the freed box while the complete payload reservation remains live.

checks.workload: Share one ordinary four MiB syntax Arc through 64 executable lookup handles.
checks.invariant: Lookup allocates nothing, preserves the original syntax address and makes no retroactive admission claim.

checks.workload: Select a two-source join with an inferred equality containing a four MiB column name.
checks.invariant: The escaped output retains its payload reservation and dropping that output returns the allowance.

checks.workload: Attach two inferred equalities including four MiB of copied column names to a selected join.
checks.invariant: Live scalar and AND-buffer reservations equal allocator-observed retained bytes; dropping the source releases them.

checks.workload: Use an exhausted ancestor and a partially sufficient allowance for two four MiB equality operands.
checks.invariant: Reject with 53200 before unadmitted copies, release partial output and preserve the original source and sibling allowance.

checks.workload: Rewrite a three-source tree whose child and parent each have a two-predicate ON conjunction.
checks.invariant: Final reservations equal live output allocation after accounting for freed input buffers; consumed intermediate AND buffers retain no charge.

checks.workload: Cancel either scope or unwind a statistics callback after a child join has published its output.
checks.invariant: The owning rewrite destroys the partial tree and releases every child output reservation on all three failure paths.

checks.workload: Retain a four MiB index payload through 64 immutable registry readers.
checks.invariant: Sharing and iteration allocate no storage, retain the original payload address, and free the registry at the last reader.

checks.workload: Capture an ordered registry before a writer removes and changes its rows.
checks.invariant: Copy-on-write publication leaves the captured generation immutable and preserves structural-key iteration order.

checks.workload: Move an ordinary row sequence with non-sorted repeated identities into a shared snapshot.
checks.invariant: Retain original sequence order, duplicate identities and payload addresses; reader and empty-snapshot clones allocate nothing.

checks.workload: Unwind the only observer after the original registry owner has transferred.
checks.invariant: Release the retained generation and all row payloads on consumer unwind.

checks.workload: Cost one indexed filter after observing an unrelated four MiB index and two candidate indexes supplied in reverse lexical order.
checks.invariant: Stay below four KiB additional allocation while selecting the same first index, callback order, predicate and exact scan cost.

checks.workload: Capture a four MiB catalog row through statement and retrieval planning and cost a parameterized query on all four providers.
checks.invariant: Both captures retain original row/payload addresses below 16 KiB allocation; costing stays below 64 KiB with 16 KiB request allowance, unchanged costs and untouched sibling reservation.

checks.workload: Retain index generations across transactional DROP/CREATE, rollback, commit, public enumeration, close and persistent reopen on all four providers.
checks.invariant: Publish the current structurally ordered registry while previous readers and mutable public copies remain independent, and preserve committed indexes after reopening.

checks.workload: Observe a pinned statement catalog after the live primary-key index has been removed.
checks.invariant: Both native planners retain the pinned row address without allocations or accidental live-catalog substitution.
